head: Chocka tells you how high to block each wheel to level your RV
dek: Lay your phone on the floor and Chocka says, for each wheel, how high it needs to go and on which step of your leveling blocks. It was #52 among paid Travel apps on the US App Store on 9 November.
details: It uses your rig's wheelbase, track and your own blocks or ramps, and works for travel trailers with a tongue jack, single or tandem axle. It calibrates in about 20 seconds. It costs $3.99 with in-app purchases, by Yaniv van der Stigchel, and needs iOS 17.
means: Leveling a camper takes fewer tries when you know each wheel's height before you start.
todo: Find Chocka in the App Store and calibrate it on a flat surface first.
thumb_words: LEVEL YOUR RV IN ONE TRY
